ai_summary: Arman Financial Services reported a strong Q1 FY27, achieving record AUM growth of 36% year-on-year and a significant turnaround to a PAT of INR 45 crores from a loss in the prior year, driven by improved asset quality (GNPA 2.76%) and operational efficiency. This positive performance stems from disciplined underwriting, strengthened independent credit and collection processes, and a strategic shift towards individual loans. However, management expresses notable caution regarding broader economic uncertainties and potential future industry-wide erosion of credit standards, despite current favorable metrics, suggesting a prudent but concerned outlook.
